speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Prolonged Breastfeeding Jaundice). The clinical picture of a 2-week-old exclusively breastfed infant with increasing jaundice and weight gain is classic for insufficient intake-related dehydration and reduced gut motility. REQUEST TEST: Total Serum Bilirubin and Direct Bilirubin.
